blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Vice President (OVP) on Monday said it would continue to provide free rides to commuters in Metro Manila from November 16 to 18, amid the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits.
